name: Ide (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ide town emblem in white: an outlined lozenge-shaped device of two hooked strokes enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Ide, a town in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ide town emblem — an outlined lozenge-shaped device of two hooked strokes enclosing a disc
